prompt: Add cancelOrder(id): it refunds the payment through the gateway, puts the items back in stock and marks the order cancelled.

requiredBehaviors: write acceptance criteria and the steps in order before the first edit
decide what happens when the refund fails after stock was already restored, or the reverse
decide what a second cancelOrder call on the same order does, so it never refunds twice
add a test for each of those failure cases
forbiddenBehaviors: start editing before naming the failure cases
stop to ask for approval of a plan that only implements what was asked
report done without evidence for each acceptance criterion
